content:
Navigation app Waze is rolling out updates to its iPhone and Android apps, adding three new AI-powered features.

The first feature uses your trip history to understand your route preferences, offering personalized navigation options...

The company says these personalized route suggestions will be presented before the standard route.

You can also use the Gemini-powered chat feature to find suitable destinations.

The conversational reporting feature is being expanded to cover permanent changes, such as road closures or business closures.

If you want less conversation rather than more, Waze also offers a 'Less Talk' mode.

Finally, Waze is beginning to gradually roll out AI-powered motorcycle navigation.

However, the latter feature is not yet available in the United States, initially limited to Argentina, Brazil, Colombia, Malaysia, Mexico, Peru, and the Philippines.
